events.verdict: Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in Thompson's (HOU) path prior to the contact.
Hyland (MIN) does not bring part of his hand under the ball when he brings his dribble to a pause.
Sengun (HOU) deflects the ball away from Hyland (MIN).
Sheppard (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Timberwolves.
McDaniels (MIN) legally contests Durant's (HOU) shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) firms up over his left leg in Thompson's (HOU) path and absorbs the contact.
Sengun (HOU) legally contests Hyland's (MIN) shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) and Randle (MIN) come together at the same spot, and incidental foot to foot contact occurs as they pursue the rebound.
DiVincenzo (MIN) and Tate (HOU) come together at the same spot as they pursue the rebound.
Tate (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the TImberwolves.
Smith Jr. (HOU) briefly grasps Randle's (MIN) jersey at the start of his drive.
Sengun (HOU) deflects the ball away from Randle (MIN).
Correctly called 24 second violation.

Sengun (HOU) takes an extra step to his right and delivers contact with his side as he sets the pick on Randle (MIN).  This contact occurs prior to, and causes, Randle to move forward into Durant (HOU).
Randle (MIN) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Durant (HOU) intentionally kicks the ball away from DiVincenzo (MIN).
Randle (MIN) brings his arm toward Smith Jr.'s (HOU) side, and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Smith Jr. (HOU) is moving alongside Randle's (MIN) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) establishes himself in Reid's (MIN) path prior to the contact.
Reid (MIN) deflects the ball away from Durant (HOU).
Gobert (MIN) cleanly blocks Durant's (HOU) shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.

Gobert (MIN) initiates contact with Sengun's (HOU) head during the inbound.  After communicating with the Replay Center, the contact occurs prior to the release of the inbounds pass and an away from the play foul is assessed.
Durant (HOU) retreats his arm into a vertical position and absorbs the contact from Randle (MIN). Sengun (HOU) then cleanly blocks the shot attempt.
Anderson (MIN) releases away from Durant (HOU) as the defenders switch.
Randle (MIN) moves alongside Sengun's (HOU) path and absorbs the contact as Sengun fades away from the basket.
Randle (MIN) brings his right arm slightly toward Sengun's (HOU) right arm, and the contact is marginal.
Randle (MIN) legally contests Thompson's (HOU) shot attempt.
Possession is awarded to the Rockets.  Sengun (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession should have been awarded to the Timberwolves.
Anderson (MIN) briefly grasps Durant's (HOU) jersey as he receives the pass.
Anderson (MIN) initiates contact with Durant's (HOU) arm that causes him to lose control of the ball.
DiVincenzo (MIN) deflects the ball away from Sengun (HOU).  Any ensuing body contact that occurs after the deflection is considered incidental.
DiVincenzo (MIN) kicks the loose ball away from Sengun (HOU), which allows DiVincenzo to gain possession.
Shannon Jr. (MIN) and Thompson (HOU) come together at the same spot as they pursue the loose ball.
Thompson's (HOU) body is out of bounds while he is still in contact with the ball.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Timberwolves.
Anderson (MIN) firms up over his left leg in Tate's (HOU) path prior to the contact.
Randle (MIN) is moving alongside Sengun's (HOU) path as he defends the drive.
Randle (MIN) retreats his arm into a vertical position as he defends Sengun's (HOU) shot attempt.
Tate (HOU) releases away from Hyland (MIN) to pursue the rebound.
Randle (MIN) applies his hand to Tate's (HOU) shoulder as he elevates, and the contact restricts Tate's ability to pursue the rebound.
Randle (MIN) brings his off-arm toward Tate's (HOU) space and marginal contact occurs as Randle releases away during the drive.
Randle (MIN) maintains verticality as he defends Durant's (HOU) shot attempt.
Shannon Jr. (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.
Shannon Jr. (MIN) deflects the ball away from Smith Jr. (HOU).
